mapper.select: SELECT fm.id, fm.field_name as item_name, fm.field_code as item_code, fm.parent_id as pid, fm.field_sort as item_order, fmf.file_url FROM safety_field_manage fm LEFT JOIN ytsafety_field_manage_file fmf ON fm.id = fmf.id WHERE fm.field_type = #{code} and fm.delete_falg = 0
SELECT t.id, t.parent_id, t.field_name FROM safety_field_manage t WHERE t.delete_falg = 0 AND t.field_type IN ('factory','region') AND t.remark IS NULL ORDER BY t.field_sort
SELECT t.id, t.parent_id, t.field_name FROM safety_field_manage t WHERE t.delete_falg = 0 AND t.field_type = 'factory' AND t.remark IS NULL ORDER BY t.field_sort
SELECT t.id, t.parent_id, t.field_name FROM safety_field_manage t WHERE t.delete_falg = 0 AND t.field_type IN ('factory','region') ORDER BY t.field_sort
